newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's three main ports shut amid bad weather.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's three main ports shut amid bad weather.

text.p: Port pilots at Mexico's three main crude shipping ports said Wednesday the ports were shut because of wind speeds of more than 60 km per hour.
Mexico's most important crude shipping terminal, Cayo Arcas in Campeche state, was closed at 1745 local/2345 GMT as wind gusts reached 35 knots (66 km/39 miles per hour), port pilots told Reuters.

Two other leading crude ports, Pajaritos in Veracruz state and Dos Bocas in Tabasco state, were closed earlier as a cold front moved southeast on the country's eastern coast. Pajaritos shut at 0730/1330 and Dos Bocas closed at 0820/1620, state-owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said.
The Communications and Transport Ministry said nine ports along the Gulf of Mexico were shut as of 1500/2100 amid strong winds from the north and waves 10 to 16 feet high.
